calendars.name: Lurist Calendar
calendars.description: The common calendar in use around the Circle Sea, established by the First Hierophancy

events.name: Founding of Reme
events.description: The mythological founding date of the ancient city of Reme

events.name: Fall of Reme
events.description: Sacking of Reme during the 1st Lurist Crusade

events.name: Founding of Balboa (City)
events.description: Documented establishment of Balboa as a Remean Port on the eastern side of the Ertran Peninsula.

events.name: Day of Names
events.description: Traditionally the day from which age was counted, supplanted in modern times by the actual day of birth. The age of majority is still determined from the most recent Day of Names, however.

events.name: High Equinox
events.description: The day of the equinox, and culmination of the festivities leading up to it

events.name: First Furrow (early)
events.description: Households carry their smallest tools to the nave steps for a blessing of hands and implements; at noon, boundary stones are chalked and light ash scattered on the first tilled ridge. In villages one still sees old habits peeking through in offerings to the Furrow Folk and Dewlasses, treated as emissaries of the Lord of Loam whose name once stood where the creed now is.

events.name: Stone Charter Day
events.description: The start of building season -- lines struck, foundations blessed, contracts haggled over at the nave door.

events.name: Shore's Blessing
events.description: Sluices are planed true, weirs scrubbed, and prayers spoken for bounty and mercy of water; riverfolk hang blue ribbons at the foot of bridges where no one will trip, participate in regattas, and fish markets sponsor free stew for the poor. Everyone knows whose favor is being courted, even as the homily speaks only of right stewardship.

events.name: Beginning of the Great Fast of Alignment
Last day of the Great Fast
High Day of the Light
events.description: Liturgical pinnacle of the year; highest feast day for the Communion of the Enlightened.

events.name: Pilgrim's Leave
events.description: Traditional day of departure for people undergoing a pilgrimage

events.name: Ashen Remembrance
events.description: A remembrance of the Fall of Reme. Chimneys are swept and firebreaks inspected; neighbourhoods run fire drills that sometimes turn competitive and raucous. In the heat's height of noon the bells and gongs ring together and the names of those lost to conflagration are read aloud. A priest gives the expected sermon on law, measure, and the sin of bending created powers to appetite, while a soft murmur runs through the crowd as people mutter an unsanctioned courtesy to the Cinder-King who scourged Reme from the face of Arlos.

events.name: Grand Conjunction
events.description: The auspicious 12-year conjunction of all three moons and the vernal equinox.

calendars.name: Remean Calendar
calendars.description: Calendar of the Ancients, no longer in use

calendars.name: Concordian Calendar
calendars.description: The calendar used by the Western Church of Stranu, functionally identical with the wider Lurist calendar but counting from the Enlightenment of the Prophet rather than the Fall of Reme.

eras.name: Since the Enlightenment of the Prophet

calendars.name: Kharunite Calendar
calendars.description: The calendar of the Kharunites, counting from the Martyrdom of their namesake Saint. It uses older Velkirian sexagesimal counting, similar to the Belanar calendar (but not synchronized to that moon).

eras.name: After the Martyrdom of Saint Kharun
